2. Primary Risk Drivers?

Volatility mixed: VXX (1W: -2.00% | 1M: -11.17%) BELOW TREND but VIX (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -8.05%) ↑ rising RECOVERY, so short-term fear ticks up inside a lower-volatility regime.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

6. Speculative Appetite?

8. Energy Trend?
Energy leadership intact: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.91%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.26% | 1M: +5.66%); natural gas UNG in RECOVERY (1W: +0.30% | 1M: -1.85%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor Energy and select Financial exposure while reducing exposure to short-term momentum Tech: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.91%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +3.73%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +5.64%); bonds TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.64% | 1M: -2.27%) to be monitored.

12. Commodities to Watch?

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive with mixed risk signals (credit stress rising vs VIX showing short-term uptick). Energy and Financials showing relative strength while Tech and speculative pockets in CORRECTION are the key divergences to monitor.
